Standing Up For Our Jewish Community | Representative Laura Gillen Skip to main content Standing Up For Our Jewish Community “New York’s Fourth Congressional District is proudly home to one of the largest Jewish communities in the country, from the Five Towns and West Hempstead to Merrick and beyond. “As your representative and a lifelong Nassau County resident, I’m committed to being a strong voice for Jewish Long Islanders, protecting our neighbors, combating rising antisemitism and defending the vital U.S.-Israel relationship. “I’m proud to have secured millions in federal security grants for synagogues, introduced bipartisan legislation to combat antisemitism and assisted Long Island families safe return home from the Middle East during international crises. I will continue working across the aisle to support our ally Israel, keep our communities safe and stand up to extremism in any form.”  – Congresswoman Laura Gillen     Image Rep. Gillen welcomed Yeshiva University students to Washington and shared her commitment to stand up for the Jewish community. Delivering Results Combating Hate & Antisemitism Congresswoman Gillen is leading bipartisan action to combat rising hate and antisemitism on campuses, in our communities and on social media. She is focused on preventing antisemitic discrimination and extreme anti-Israel hostility on college campuses. She has also worked to improve Holocaust education and awareness and protect all students’ right to learn without fear. Rep. Gillen’s legislation includes: Jewish American Security Act (H.R. 9211): Rep. Gillen co-led a  bipartisan package with Reps. Dan Goldman (D-NY-10) and Mike Lawler (R-NY-17) to provide $1 billion annually for the Nonprofit Security Grant Program (NSGP), which provides grants to protect synagogues and yeshivas, to increase college campus protections against antisemitism, to improve threat and hate crime reporting and to tackle online antisemitism.   Bipartisan Task Force to Combat Antisemitism: Rep. Rep. Gillen Earns Top Grade for Bipartisanship in Congress | Representative Laura Gillen Skip to main content Rep. Gillen Earns Top Grade for Bipartisanship in Congress August 6, 2026 Press Release WASHINGTON, DC —  Today, Congresswoman Laura Gillen (NY-04) announced that she earned a 96.5 Bridge Score and an “A” grade in the latest  Bridge Grades report  evaluating the 119th Congress. The score places Rep. Gillen among the highest-rated members of the U.S. House of Representatives for bipartisan collaboration. “At a time of deep division, I’m glad to be named one of the most bipartisan members of Congress and will continue to push hyper- partisanship aside to deliver results for Nassau County, "  said Rep. Gillen . “I was sent to Congress to work with anyone, from either party, to solve problems and get things done for Long Island. That’s why I’ve worked across the aisle to lower costs, keep Long Islanders safe and fix our broken immigration system.” Bridge Grades is a nonpartisan initiative of the Mediators Foundation that evaluates every member of Congress using objective, third-party data measuring bipartisan collaboration. The methodology places greater emphasis on direct bipartisan legislative action than on public statements. Since taking office, Rep. Gillen has emphasized bipartisan cooperation, with every bill she has  introduced  in Congress earning bipartisan support. She has one of the most centrist voting records in Congress, according to  UCLA’s Voteview and  CQ Roll Call . She has worked across the aisle to pass a  bipartisan extension of Temporary Protected Status (TPS) for Haitians and has secured key legislative language in multiple bipartisan  bills, reflecting her commitment to advancing practical, consensus-driven solutions. ###  Media Press Releases In the News Back to top button
